subject: cuda-nbody

children.objective: In src/nbody_kernel.cu, test a thread-per-output implementation that cooperatively stages source-particle data in shared-memory tiles and reuses each tile across destination threads. Explore compatible block and items_per_block settings in src/launch.json. Handle source and output tails and self-interaction correctly; add no launches or host work. Measure all official sizes and retain only versions passing the full correctness suite.
children.subject: Shared-memory source tiling and reuse

children.objective: In src/nbody_kernel.cu, investigate a warp-cooperative source reduction, such as assigning a warp to an output particle and having lanes accumulate different source indices before reducing the force components. Tune the block and items_per_block mapping in src/launch.json. Handle arbitrary N, self-interactions, tails, output ownership, and changed floating-point summation order; preserve exact masses and pass all correctness checks before comparing timings.
children.subject: Warp-parallel source traversal and reduction

children.objective: In src/nbody_kernel.cu, optimize the direct thread-per-output arithmetic path by evaluating explicit rsqrtf-based inverse-distance arithmetic and, only if accuracy permits, cancellation of target-mass multiply/divide operations. Do not enable global fast math or assume algebraic equivalence guarantees acceptable float32 results. Preserve behavior for coincident positions, varying positive and extreme masses, and all dt values; keep exact output masses and require full correctness before measuring the official sizes.
children.subject: Per-interaction math and instruction reduction
